title: Zone Transfers
subtitle: Secondary nameservers that copy this server's DNS zones
secondariesHelp: Each server listed here may copy (AXFR) all {count} zones this server is primary for, and is sent a NOTIFY whenever one changes.
none: No secondaries. Only this server answers for its zones.
label: Name (optional)
removeConfirm: Stop {address} from copying zones from this server?
step1: Add each zone there as a secondary zone with this server's IP as its primary. On another dPanel server: DNS Zones → Add domains, type slave.
step2: Give the secondary a nameserver name and list it with this server's ({nameservers}) in DNS_OUR_NAMESERVERS, so every zone carries its NS record.
step3: Add the secondary's name at each domain's registrar, next to this server's.
copiedHelp: Secondary zones: PowerDNS copies them from their primary and keeps them up to date. Their records are changed on the primary.
noCopied: None. Add one under DNS Zones with the type slave.
